title: Carry a parks budget across years
heading: Multi-Period Carry-Over Is a Stock Variable That Links Each Year's Cash Row to the Next
cases: money a year cannot spend rolls into the next year and is spent there
the carry cap is a share of the budget of the year the money leaves, not the year it enters
the first year has nothing carried in, not the last year's carry
money neither spent nor carried lapses, so a year may leave some unused
